title: pre-machine two-coordinate/layered-sheet provenance

historical_findings.finding: community explicitly generated A-I sticker tables in both left-to-right and top-to-bottom orientations
community proposed that letters could provide one horizontal/vertical position and numbers the other, placing stickers on a two-dimensional sheet, with further layered structure underneath
community proposed DTMF/Polybius-like two-coordinate structure and then a two-layer larger-domain plus smaller-selector architecture

relation_to_experiment_386: These pre-machine proposals independently support treating sticker evidence as coordinate roles that may exchange horizontal/vertical placement and layer/index roles. They do not specify the exact c,r,k -> Q,c,r permutation or q reversal.
epistemic_effect: upgrade operation-class provenance for coordinate-role reinterpretation and layered 2D placement; no upgrade to exact role assignment
